title: Project Manager
description:
Reports to: Managing Director 
 Location: Ahmedabad (Head Office base), with extensive travel across active project sites 
 Direct reports: Project Engineers / Site Managers; plant and machinery in-charges; site supervisory teams 

 Role Purpose Own end-to-end project delivery across the entire division execution, quality, cost, schedule, safety, and plant utilisation. 
 Key Responsibilities Project Execution & Delivery Own delivery of all active and incoming road projects to scope, schedule, and budget, with project-level P&L accountability. Run high-volume, multi-work programmes many small parallel sub-works executed simultaneously with disciplined pre-construction and billing throughput, recognising the pre-construction cell as the critical bottleneck. Resolve site-level execution hindrances (alignment, encroachment, approvals, obstruction) and keep works moving. Quality & Technical Standards Ensure all bituminous (DBM/BC) and RCC work meets specification and the standards of the relevant government and municipal authorities. Drive quality systems, material testing, and adherence to estimated vs. actual quantities; eliminate rework and length-variance leakage. Plant, Machinery & Resources Maximise utilisation of the company’s batch mix plants, mechanised paving equipment, and vehicle fleet; minimise idle time and breakdowns. Own on-site fuel discipline (diesel/LDO efficiency) and coordinate closely with Procurement on bitumen, aggregates, cement, and steel. Cost & Productivity Drive on-site cost control and productivity against estimated norms; own daily progress reporting (DPR) discipline and site-level reporting to the MD. People & Leadership Development Build, lead, and motivate the site management organisation across all locations. Personally mentor the two designated high-potential engineers through their 18-month path to division-head readiness — an explicit, measured part of the mandate. Client Interface (Execution Level) Manage day-to-day relationships with client engineers and officials; own measurement books and the site-side substantiation of running account (RA) bills. Safety, Compliance & Systems Ensure site safety, and labour, statutory, and environmental compliance at sites and plants. Institutionalise SOPs so delivery is repeatable and not founder-dependent. 
 Qualifications & Experience B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering (M.Tech or MBA an advantage). 10–20 years in road/highway/infrastructure construction, with proven experience running multiple sites simultaneously . Deep, hands-on bituminous and RCC road execution experience; familiarity with batch mix plant and mechanised paving operations. Strong track record with government and municipal clients and their measurement and billing systems. Experience leading large site teams; ideally exposure to a firm that scaled or professionalised.

Key Skills: Construction Management,Highway Construction,Road Construction,Civil Construction,Civil Project Management,Project management,Project,Civil Project
